components.name: Landing Pill (primary CTA)
components.description: The landing's only filled-button voice: nav, hero, plan cards, open-source strip.
components.css: .ds-pill { border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 13px 28px; font: 600 15px 'Inter Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; color: #fff; background: #6c5ce7; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-pill:hover { background: #5a49e0; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8c7cf6; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Landing Pill (ghost)
components.description: Secondary landing action: hairline border, transparent ground.
components.css: .ds-pill-ghost { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); border-radius: 999px; padding: 13px 28px; font: 600 15px 'Inter Variable', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; color: #f4f5f9; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-pill-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }

components.name: App primary button
components.description: In-app action button: 6px radius, fill-grade violet.
components.css: .ds-btn { border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 6px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 13px 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; color: #fff; background: #6c5ce7; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #5a49e0; }

components.name: Landing eyebrow (surface signature)
components.description: Brief-pinned landing signature; mono lowercase in parentheses. Never propagates to app surfaces.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 14px; font: 500 12px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; color: #8c7cf6; }

components.name: Browser-framed product shot
components.description: The landing's only imagery: real screenshots, three-dot chrome, deep offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-shot { margin: 0; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); background: #1a1c24; box-shadow: 0 32px 64px -24px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); overflow: hidden; } .ds-shot-bar { display: flex; gap: 7px; padding: 11px 14px; background: #171922; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); } .ds-shot-bar i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-shot-bar i:nth-child(1) { background: #e8613c; } .ds-shot-bar i:nth-child(2) { background: #f0b83e; } .ds-shot-bar i:nth-child(3) { background: #59b75f; } .ds-shot img { display: block; width: 100%; }

narrative.northStar: The Prism in the Dark Room（暗房里的棱镜）
narrative.overview: 深海军蓝的界面世界里只点一盏紫罗兰灯：产品名里的 prism 是唯一强调色，其余一切用面板深浅与发丝线分层。Manrope 承担展示性标题、Inter 承担界面正文（均自托管），等宽字体承担全部 LaTeX 身份。暗色是默认主题；深度靠底色台阶，不靠影。
keyCharacteristics: 深底分层 app→inset→toolbar→panel→raised，深度靠底色台阶不靠影
单强调色：紫罗兰一家（text 级 #8c7cf6 / fill 级 #6c5ce7）
圆角阶梯 4/6/8/12px；胶囊 999px 只属于小控件与落地 CTA
落地面独有语法：等宽眉标、浏览器框截图、全宽深带

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: 紫罗兰是唯一强调色；出现即意味着可点或可注目。蓝绿橙不进入这个世界（语义色除外）。

rules.name: The Wash Steps Up Rule
rules.body: 紫色文字落在 violet wash 上必须升亮档 #a49dfa——wash 抬高地面后原对比跌破 4.5:1。

rules.name: The Mono Is Identity Rule
rules.body: 等宽字体只写代码、venue 名与眉标——它是 LaTeX 的母语，不做通用科技感装扮。

rules.name: The Shadow States Purpose Rule
rules.body: 影只在陈述「这是一块悬着的屏幕/浮层」；静态卡片不加影。

dos: Do 每个落地面节配一个等宽小写眉标；应用面不加。
Do 落地面中段行动点用紫字链接；实心胶囊只放 nav/hero/定价/收尾四处。
Do 图像一律真实截图+浏览器框；营销数字只用已核实事实。
Do 紫文字落 violet wash 上时升亮档（#a49dfa）。
donts: Don't 引入第二强调色或渐变；蓝绿橙不出现（语义色除外）。
Don't 把眉标/胶囊/浏览器框带进应用界面——那是落地面专属语法。
Don't 用插画、图标库、emoji、点阵替代真实截图。
Don't 在对外表面出现 github.com 链接、价格数字、编造的备案号（PRODUCT.md 红线）。
